summary: Frontend visual verification of two approved UI changes: (1) landing hero dark navy band with white bold heading + twinkle particles + blue radial glow (no purple), and (2) /courses cards using live mini-mockups (interview/excel/doc) instead of stock photos. Also re-verified tailwind font-mono → 'Spline Sans Mono' fix from iteration_90. Backend testing skipped per request.

ui_bugs.issue: Visual: the 'ADVANCED' pink difficulty badge on the 'Private Equity & Deal Structuring' card renders with a noticeable inter-glyph gap that reads visually as 'AD VANCED', even though DOM textContent is single-word 'Advanced' and height=23px (single line, whitespace:nowrap, letter-spacing:0.25px). Root cause appears to be a font-kerning/rendering quirk with the applied font ('Instrument Sans' resolved from `font-bricolage` class at 10px + tracking-wide + text-transform:uppercase). Not a wrap, not a layout collision, purely a font-rendering artifact but user-visible. All other badges (BEGINNER, INTERMEDIATE, BEGINNER TO INTERMEDIATE) render clean.

verifications_passed: Landing / loads with 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors at both 1920x1080 and 390x844

Hero .hero-on-dark band present with dark radial-gradient (rgb(35,48,74) → rgb(20,27,39) → rgb(10,15,22)) — dark navy confirmed, NO purple/violet colors detected in band (purple color scan returned [])
H1 renders 'A new way of mastering\nfinance in the age of AI' in rgb(255,255,255) white with font-weight 600 (bold)
46 .hero-particle twinkle dots rendered in the band (matches spec of ~46)
Blue accent color (#246BFD family) used on 'age of AI' italic and CTA — no purple

Navbar at scrollY=0 has class 'nav-on-dark-hero' and light nav links (rgba(255,255,255,0.72)) — dark-hero override IS applied and specificity works correctly (bug flagged in review as previously fixed remains fixed)
Navbar after scroll>50px switches to 'lv-nav-scrolled' with opaque light bg — original behavior preserved
Primary CTA 'Start Free Session' → /signup, Secondary 'See the full curriculum' → /course/<id> — both correctly linked and visible on dark band
Product showcase tabs (AI MOCK INTERVIEW / EXCEL MODELLING / DOCUMENT SIMULATION) present below hero band

/courses: all 6 real+mock course cards render with vvm-mini components (no thumbnails). Assignments verified: Equity Research Analyst→interview, Portfolio Management Essentials→interview, Investment Banking Fundamentals→excel, Financial Modelling in Excel→excel, Private Equity & Deal Structuring→doc, Wealth Management for Advisors→doc — matches spec exactly
Difficulty badge (top-left) and status badge (top-right) sit above mini-mockup header without collision on all cards

font-mono class now correctly resolves to 'Spline Sans Mono', ui-monospace, monospace (previous iteration_90 minor issue FIXED). Meta rows '60 hrs', '20 modules', '215 sessions' and category label 'EQUITY RESEARCH' all compute to 'Spline Sans Mono'
action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: If the visual gap in the 'ADVANCED' difficulty badge is deemed noticeable, consider either (a) removing tracking-wide, (b) reducing letter-spacing to 0, or (c) switching the badge font from font-bricolage (which is falling back to 'Instrument Sans') to a font with better uppercase kerning like Spline Sans. All other difficulty labels render fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav-on-dark-hero override css correctly wins specificity over landing-light/landing-dark navbar rules — bug flagged in review as previously fixed IS actually fixed.

`font-bricolage` Tailwind class does not appear to map to Bricolage Grotesque in the loaded stack — computedStyle resolves to 'Instrument Sans'. Not affecting functionality but worth noting if Bricolage was intended for badges.
Hero band uses hardcoded dark styling via `.hero-on-dark` regardless of light/dark toggle — intentional per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both approved UI changes verified working. Hero dark band + white bold heading + 46 particles + blue glow (no purple) confirmed. All /courses cards swap photos for MiniInterview/MiniExcel/MiniDoc mockups correctly. Only observation is a minor visual kerning quirk on the pink 'ADVANCED' difficulty badge that visually reads 'AD VANCED' due to font kerning (not a wrap/layout bug). Tailwind font-mono → Spline Sans Mono fix from iteration_90 confirmed working.
